notes.title: BattleTitan RAINBOW – Dev Update (May 2025)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/0f3e66b51fee5d1fd71b09faaf3e0aac52951804.png[/img]
BattleTitan RAINBOW – Dev Update (May 2025)[b]
[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/e81f2f1fc42cbfb35504be453c8a58bd4bd486b0.jpg[/img]
[b]Steam Deck Testing Initiated[/b]
CPU and GPU usage around 30%. Steam Deck surprisingly powerful, running smoother than low-end laptops with integrated GPUs.

[b]Menu Development[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/71055c493e3f6597658a145b56bd508a053c7cad.jpg[/img]
[b]A. Start Screen[/b]
Three types of start screens configured. Currently in development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/d77c9a7d2ce55f43d4302143530ad0f50a03a877.jpg[/img]
[b]B. Gallery Mode[/b]
Organized to allow browsing of characters, mechanics, and events from the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/2903202f86c25122b5a3cedaefce17f7fcafb79e.jpg[/img]
[b]C. Ranking Screen[/b]
Currently, Demo doesn't support Steam leaderboards; local leaderboard operational.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/aa0c9ad4720395a9bd9d3dadd33accbe6859255f.jpg[/img]
[b]D. Name Entry Screen[/b]
Allows players to change initials for leaderboard records. Designed with retro arcade game aesthetics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/229b596b749c8af83370d5203ca6a0685af16157.jpg[/img]
[b]E. Input Key Configuration[/b]
Implemented customizable key mapping. The process was unexpectedly complex, highlighting why many indie games don't support this feature.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/fb7278017d1a8f4d6595d1104ccbac8d0efdfa14.jpg[/img]
[b]Extra Language Support[/b]
Final language option [Extra] defaults to English, but players can modify CSV files to change languages freely.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/cc0ab96aaedf23e6db9dd10152188afff7ccb53b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/ee624d43a713d48de9fae920eb5d9a0cd17a8b1b.jpg[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/56b618860cd683f598c642d44344d99352377cb7.jpg[/img]

[b]Event [Artwork] Development Ongoing[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/a4a6244a8ddfed1fb0acca1135608a7d6b0b21eb.jpg[/img]
[b]Developing the final Demo build during May[/b]
Includes Arcade 1, Story 1, and Boss Match 1 modes.

notes.title: Change game release date
notes.notes:
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/0f3e66b51fee5d1fd71b09faaf3e0aac52951804.png[/img]

Hello, players.

I am a developer from Battle Titan Rainbow.

We have been working tirelessly on the development of the game, and as a result, we have made progress in the development of the Arcade mode, "Ashura Heaven Palace Fall," and the RPG mode, "강호행 (Gangho Journey)." We participated in the 2023 PlayX4 Indie Game B2B event held in South Korea and had the opportunity to connect with various publishers.

However, we have determined that we have not reached the desired level of game quality yet. Consequently, we have made the decision to postpone the release date from 2023.2Q to 2024.2Q.

To complete the RPG mode, "강호행 (Gangho Journey)," we realized that it requires much more development power than initially anticipated. Developing both modes to a satisfactory quality level would take a significant amount of time with our current resources.

Currently, our development team is focusing on completing the Arcade mode, "Ashura Heaven Palace Fall."

We apologize to all the players who were looking forward to the Early Access stage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43324691/f3829e62d4878de05716006d3d9f1502c26b44a1.png[/img]
